characters.summary: Gigantamax Eevee fights by overwhelming opponents with its massive physical size, fluffy fur that makes foes fall for its charm, and normal-type energy attacks like G-Max Cuddle.

mechanisms: Massive size and increased health pool typical of Gigantamax forms
Fluffy fur that can infatuate opponents of the opposite gender

limitations: Gigantamax effect wears off after three turns.
characters.formDifferences: Changes Eevee into a massive 59-foot-tall Pokémon with extra fluffy neck fur and gives it the ability to use G-Max Cuddle instead of standard Gigantamax moves.

sources.supports: Gigantamax Eevee form characteristics, abilities, and G-Max Cuddle.

feats.claim: Uses its fluffy fur to infatuate opponents and utilizes the exclusive G-Max Cuddle move in its Gigantamax state.

conditional.ability: Gigantamax transformations, including the use of G-Max Cuddle
conditional.dependsOn: Gigantamax factor and Dynamax energy in specific regions such as Galar

campaignTags.claim: Gigantamax Eevee grows to a massive height of 59'00".

unknowns: Exact endurance limits of Gigantamax fur outside of standard battle conditions.

characters.continuity: Pokémon standard video game and anime continuity
characters.summary: Ekans is a serpentine Pokémon that strikes from stealth using its stealthy slither and constricts foes with its body or poisons them with fangs.

mechanisms: Shed Skin ability allowing recovery from status conditions
Intimidate ability to lower opponent attack power

limitations: Short physical reach compared to larger serpentine Pokémon.

sources.supports: Ekans abilities, moveset, and combat style.

feats.claim: Constricts prey with its flexible body and poisons foes using sharp fangs.

campaignTags.claim: Silently slithers through grass to ambush prey.

unknowns: Exact maximum length of constriction pressure.

characters.continuity: Pokémon standard video game and anime continuity
characters.summary: Electabuzz fights by channeling and discharging high-voltage electricity at opponents while utilizing close-combat punches.

mechanisms: Static ability which can paralyze attackers on contact
Agility to dodge incoming attacks

limitations: Vulnerable to grounding effects that neutralize electricity.

sources.supports: Electabuzz electric attacks, abilities, and combat characteristics.

feats.claim: Absorbs electricity from power plants to fuel its energy levels.

campaignTags.claim: Naturally generates and fires powerful electrical discharges.
Manipulates ambient electricity and absorbs electrical currents to heal.

unknowns: Exact upper limit of voltage output.

characters.continuity: Pokémon standard video game and anime continuity
characters.summary: Electrode relies on explosive speed and volatile self-destruction tactics, utilizing electric shocks and high mobility to overwhelm targets.

mechanisms: Extreme movement speed making it difficult to target
Soundproof ability preventing sound-based attacks

limitations: Self-Destruct and Explosion moves incapacitate Electrode upon use.

sources.supports: Electrode high speed, electric moves, and self-destruction mechanics.

feats.claim: Rolls at extreme speeds to ram opponents and detonates itself when agitated.

campaignTags.claim: Stores vast amounts of electrical energy inside its body, causing it to detonate easily.
Emits powerful electric pulses and sparks.

unknowns: Exact mechanics of how it stores electricity without constant detonation.

characters.continuity: Pokémon standard video game and anime continuity
characters.summary: Exeggcute fights collectively as a cluster of six seed-like beings, utilizing psychic waves and status-inflicting spores to confound enemies.

mechanisms: Telepathic coordination between all six bodies to evade attacks
Chlorophyll ability in sunlight

limitations: Fragile individual components easily damaged if separated.

sources.supports: Exeggcute psychic and grass moves, group telepathy, and vulnerabilities.

feats.claim: Maintains constant telepathic connection so that if one is separated, the others quickly rejoin it.

campaignTags.claim: Communicates via telepathic waves linking all six members.

unknowns: Whether each egg possesses a distinct individual consciousness or shares a single hive mind.

characters.continuity: Pokémon standard video game and anime continuity
characters.summary: Exeggutor uses towering height, heavy psychic waves, and grass-type barrage attacks from its multiple coconut-like heads.

mechanisms: Sturdy trunks and thick foliage shielding core body
Harvest ability to reuse berries

limitations: Heads can occasionally argue with each other, creating tactical openings.

sources.supports: Exeggutor baseline stats, moves, typing, and abilities.

feats.claim: Each of its three heads thinks independently, allowing it to overwhelm opponents with varied attacks.

campaignTags.claim: Fires concentrated psychic beams from its multiple heads.
Stands at an impressive height of over 6 feet.

unknowns: Exact distribution of cognitive control among the three heads.

characters.summary: Alolan Exeggutor utilizes its extreme dragon-like neck and tail head to sweep opponents with physical momentum and heavy dragon energy.

mechanisms: Frisk ability to inspect opponent items
Height advantage keeping main body out of melee range

limitations: Tail head operates independently to protect the rear, but the long neck is unwieldy in tight spaces.
characters.formDifferences: Adds Dragon typing, removes Psychic typing, drastically increases height to over 35 feet, and adds a fourth head on its tail.

sources.supports: Alolan Exeggutor regional form, Dragon typing, and unique height.

feats.claim: Uses its long neck like a whip to strike opponents with massive physical force via Dragon Hammer.

campaignTags.claim: Grows to an immense height of 35'09" due to strong Alolan sunlight.

unknowns: The precise evolutionary trigger in Alola that caused its neck to lengthen so drastically.

characters.continuity: Pokémon standard video game and anime continuity
characters.summary: Farfetch'd engages in martial combat using a leek stalk as both a sword and a shield, relying on sharp reflexes and precise strikes.

mechanisms: Parrying attacks with its leek stalk
Inner Focus ability to prevent flinching

limitations: Helpless if disarmed of its leek stalk, forced to search for a replacement.

sources.supports: Farfetch'd leek weapon usage, moveset, and typing.

feats.claim: Uses its leek stalk with master precision to slice through objects and defend against blows.

conditional.ability: Advanced weapon techniques utilizing the leek stalk
conditional.dependsOn: Possession of its vital leek stalk

campaignTags.claim: Has wings and can fly short distances.

unknowns: How it determines which leek stalk is suitable for combat.

characters.summary: Galarian Farfetch'd fights with a heavy leek stalk and shield, charging opponents with brutal momentum and high critical-hit frequency.

mechanisms: Shield formed from thick leek leaves
Steadfast ability increasing speed when flinched

limitations: Must rest after executing heavy attacks like Meteor Assault due to weapon recoil.
characters.formDifferences: Changes typing from Normal/Flying to pure Fighting, replaces the thin leek with a massive leek stalk and leaf shield, and alters its evolution path.

sources.supports: Galarian Farfetch'd Fighting type, heavy leek usage, and signature moves.

feats.claim: Charges opponents with the force of its heavy leek, culminating in retiring from battle after executing Meteor Assault.

unknowns: Exact structural weight of the Galarian leek stalk.

characters.continuity: Pokémon standard video game and anime continuity
characters.summary: Fearow dominates aerial combat by diving from high altitudes with razor-sharp beak strikes and sweeping wing attacks.

mechanisms: Keen Eye ability preventing accuracy reduction
High aerial velocity to evade ground-based attacks

limitations: Vulnerable to close-range counterattacks if its high-speed dive misses.

sources.supports: Fearow aerial combat capabilities, Drill Peck, and stats.

feats.claim: Spins its long, sharp beak like a drill to pierce targets during high-speed dives.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses large wings capable of soaring in the sky for entire days without resting.

unknowns: Maximum diving speed achievable in a terminal velocity descent.
